newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabian shares little changed in the week.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabian shares little changed in the week.

text.p: Shares on the Saudi stock market were little changed last week in lower volume trade, figures from Riyadh-based Bakheet Financial Advisors (BFA) showed on Sunday.
The index was barely changed in the week to Thursday at 137.10 points.
Volume fell to 2.78 million shares from the previous week's 3.23 million shares and the value of shares traded declined to 395.67 million riyals ($105.5 million) from 444.7 million riyals.
BFA figures showed 55 firms were traded last week. Share prices of 18 rose, 24 dropped and 13 were unchanged.
Service sector shares dominated trade, accounting for 49 percent of turnover, followed by cement shares with 28 percent.
With 545,151 shares traded, Arriyadh Development remained the most active share by volume, accounting for over 19 percent of total turnover, BFA figures show.
It ended at 71 riyals from 74 riyals at the end of the previous week.
Other active shares were Saudi Cement, with 286,689 shares worth 51.74 million riyals changing hands.
